type Color = Red | Green | Blue

fn too_many(p: (Int, Int)) -> Int
  example too_many((1, 2)) == 1
do
  match p do
    case (a, b, c) =>
      return a + b + c
  end match
end fn

fn not_a_tuple(n: Int) -> Int
  example not_a_tuple(1) == 1
do
  match n do
    case (a, b) =>
      return a
  end match
end fn

fn wrong_size() -> (Int, Int)
  example wrong_size() == (1, 2)
do
  return (1, 2, 3)
end fn

fn wrong_element() -> (Int, Text)
  example wrong_element() == (1, "a")
do
  return (1, 2)
end fn

fn missing_case(c: Color, flag: Bool) -> Int
  example missing_case(Red, true) == 1
do
  match (c, flag) do
    case (Red, true) =>
      return 1
    case (Green, _) =>
      return 2
    case (Blue, false) =>
      return 3
  end match
end fn

fn wrong_return(p: (Int, Int)) -> (Int, Int, Int)
  example wrong_return((1, 2)) == (1, 2, 3)
do
  return p
end fn
